kind_note: 4th-millennium planned town on Syrian Euphrates; DOG excavations

summary.zh: 叙利亚幼发拉底河畔第四千纪规划城镇；德国东方学会发掘；Strommenger 1980 介绍发掘成果与南部/乌鲁克相关物质文化。解释性「乌鲁克扩张」模型见假说栏。
summary.en: Fourth-millennium planned town on the Syrian Euphrates excavated by the Deutsche Orient-Gesellschaft; Strommenger 1980 presents results and southern/Uruk-related material culture. Interpretive ‘Uruk expansion’ model remains a hypothesis claim.

editorial.notes: New site outside southern alluvium but sourced for Uruk-related contact; coords omitted.
